stops.name: Karls- und Bärenhöhle
stops.detail: The Karls- und Bärenhöhle, also Erpfinger Cave, is located about two kilometres northeast of the Sonnenbühler district of Erpfingen in the rock of the white Jurakalk. Colloquially, however, the term bear cave is used for the entire cave. With about 80,000 visitors annually, it is the most visited show cave of the Swabian Alb and one of the most visited caves in Germany.
